strongest_objection: The map's own boundary rule kills two of its members. The boundary claim and the gate's boundary case both say that a market which clears at a lower or a hostage price is alive, and on that rule the author cut Crash and Corner. But Fence rots as written is a crash of a fenced right: the New York medallion fell to a tenth and still trades at that tenth, with the fence half held and the use going on, which is exactly the excluded case of a market alive at a lower price. And Witness starving as written is not a death at all but the condition before one: the physical trades continue, the item states a tell and a cure rather than a death and a rebirth, and by the author's own Corner ruling a print set by one cargo is a market alive at a hostage price. Both mechanisms are real and the deaths exist at their limits, so the repair is to say where the limit is: a fence has rotted to death when the right trades at the price of its paperwork, and a starving witness has died when a cargo is traded to move the print rather than to move oil. Behind that, three illustrative cases are asserted as documented history and are wrong or overclaimed: the American genetic non-discrimination statute covers health cover and employment and does not reach the life-insurance pool the item names; the participants who left nickel after the 2022 cancellation did come back, with the venue's nickel volume recovering strongly in 2024, and the item's own edge to Copy takes the crowd says a cancellation without a copy should leave the market alive and distrusted, which is what happened; and the structured-credit revival was rated by the same agencies under a new rule, against the item's claim that rebirth needs a grader with fresh credit. Everything else survived what I tried: the strange members (a corpse kept warm by contracts, a hand on the saddle, a death by too much knowledge, relics moving by pious theft) are real mechanisms with distinct tells, the band-of-ignorance incompatibility is an inference the bare list could not make, and my own closest pair separated.

items.item: Witness starving: a benchmark rests on a physical market whose flow thins until one cargo sets the print for everything indexed to it, as the Brent field declined to a few cargoes a month under contracts worth many times the field; the tell is a single trade moving the month's print, and a party with reason to make that trade; the assessor's cure is to widen the basket, which feeds the witness by changing the lot; not Warm corpse, where the trades have stopped, since here they continue, too few to bear the weight on them.
items.why: States a tell and a cure but no death and no rebirth, which the declared type requires; the trades continue and the print is set by one cargo, which is the author's own excluded case of a market alive at a hostage price. The death is real and lies one step further: when a cargo is traded to move the print rather than to move oil, the physical market has become a bet on the paper written over it and is no longer a market for the cargo.
items.repair: Witness starving: a benchmark rests on a physical market whose flow thins until one cargo sets the print for everything indexed to it, and the market dies as a market for the cargo on the day a cargo is traded to move the print rather than to move oil, since the physical trades are now bets on the paper written over them, as the Brent field declined to a few cargoes a month under contracts worth many times the field; the tell is a single trade moving the month's print, and a party with reason to make that trade; rebirth requires the assessor to widen the basket, which feeds the witness by changing the lot; not Warm corpse, where the trades have stopped, since here they continue, too few to bear the weight on them and made for the weight's sake.

items.item: Fence rots: a lot that was a lot only because a fence was held dies when the fence goes unpoliced, so the lot's price falls while the underlying use goes on, as the New York taxi medallion fell from over a million dollars to a tenth of it while more rides than ever were driven; the tell is the price of the fenced right falling faster than the price of the use; rebirth needs the fence re-held, and the death spends the will to hold it, since the fence's beneficiaries are now a small ruined group and its violators are everyone's drivers; the reversal of market-births' Fence at the lot's edge, which the market could draw but only a state could hold.
items.why: As illustrated it is a price collapse of a fenced right that still clears at a tenth, which the map's boundary claim rules alive. The mechanism is a death only at full rot, when the right trades at the price of its paperwork; the medallion is the partial case and should be marked as one, and the discriminator must exclude the crash of a still-held fence.
items.repair: Fence rots: a lot that was a lot only because a fence was held dies when the fence goes unpoliced enough that the fenced right trades at the price of its paperwork while the underlying use goes on, as the New York taxi medallion fell from over a million dollars toward a tenth of it while more rides than ever were driven, a death still in progress since the fence is half held and the medallion half priced; the tell is the price of the fenced right falling faster than the price of the use, and the death is complete when the two no longer move together at all; rebirth needs the fence re-held, and the death spends the will to hold it, since the fence's beneficiaries are now a small ruined group and its violators are everyone's drivers; the reversal of market-births' Fence at the lot's edge, which the market could draw but only a state could hold, and not a crash of the right, which is a fence still held at a lower rent.

items.item: Print taken back: a market dies from the top when the party that made trades final unmakes one, since every later trade is then provisional, as the London Metal Exchange cancelled a morning of nickel trades in March 2022 and the participants who had won the cancelled trades took their volume elsewhere and did not come back; the tell is a rulebook that now shows the power, and a competitor's open interest rising in the same lot; rebirth requires a clearer whose rulebook lacks the power, and the belief in finality is rebuilt one uncancelled crisis at a time; not a default, which is a counterparty failing, but the witness declining to witness.
items.why: The case contradicts the map's own edge. The edge to Copy takes the crowd says a cancellation with no copy leaves the market alive and distrusted; nickel had no exact copy in 2022, and the venue's nickel volume fell for two years and then recovered strongly in 2024, so 'did not come back' is an illustrative case asserted as documented history and wrong. The tell 'a competitor's open interest rising in the same lot' also presupposes the copy the case lacked. Keep the mechanism, make the case honest, and make the with-copy and without-copy outcomes explicit in the item.
items.repair: Print taken back: a market dies from the top when the party that made trades final unmakes one, since every later trade is then provisional, as the London Metal Exchange cancelled a morning of nickel trades in March 2022 and the participants who had won the cancelled trades took their volume elsewhere for two years; the tell is a rulebook that now shows the power, and, where a copy exists, its open interest rising in the same lot; where no copy exists the venue survives, distrusted, and its volume drifts back one uncancelled crisis at a time, as nickel's did; rebirth requires a clearer whose rulebook lacks the power, or the belief in finality rebuilt by crises that pass without a cancellation; not a default, which is a counterparty failing, but the witness declining to witness.

items.item: Farm comes back: a grade that let lots substitute fails when its issuer's word stops meaning what it says, so every lot must again be inspected to its own origin, which costs more than the trade, and the market dies not from distrust but from the cost of the inspections distrust demands, as the triple-A on structured paper failed in 2007 and each pool had to be re-underwritten loan by loan; the tell is a bid-ask that widens lot by lot rather than across the board, and buyers asking for the documents behind the grade; rebirth needs a grader with fresh credit rather than a reformed one, since the old grade's memory is poisoned; the reversal of market-births' Grade that erases the farm.
items.why: The rebirth clause, 'a grader with fresh credit rather than a reformed one, since the old grade's memory is poisoned', is speculation promoted to fact and contradicted by the case it rides on: the securitization markets that revived after 2009 were rated by the same three agencies, under risk retention and new rating rules. What was re-credited was the rule, not the name. The mechanism and tell are sound.
items.repair: Farm comes back: a grade that let lots substitute fails when its issuer's word stops meaning what it says, so every lot must again be inspected to its own origin, which costs more than the trade, and the market dies not from distrust but from the cost of the inspections distrust demands, as the triple-A on structured paper failed in 2007 and each pool had to be re-underwritten loan by loan; the tell is a bid-ask that widens lot by lot rather than across the board, and buyers asking for the documents behind the grade; rebirth needs the grade's word re-credited, by a new grader or by the old one under a new rule, and in structured credit the old graders kept the job under risk retention, so what was re-credited was the rule and not the name; the reversal of market-births' Grade that erases the farm.

items.item: Test before the pool: a market for risk dies when the risk becomes known before the trade, since the pool that priced the unknown dissolves into the certain-loss, who cannot be insured, and the certain-safe, who will not pay, as a genetic test does to a life-insurance pool; the tell is the seller asking for the test; what the death spends is ignorance, which no one can rebuild once the test exists, so rebirth requires a witness built not to see, as genetic non-discrimination law forbids the insurer to ask; the mirror of Farm comes back, which is death by too little known about the lot, this is death by too much.
items.why: The illustrative rebirth is misattributed: the American Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act covers health insurance and employment and expressly leaves life, disability, and long-term-care cover outside, so it does not forbid the life insurer the item names to ask. Canada's 2017 act and the British insurers' moratorium do. The mechanism, the tell, and the closing discriminator are the map's best and stand.
items.repair: Test before the pool: a market for risk dies when the risk becomes known before the trade, since the pool that priced the unknown dissolves into the certain-loss, who cannot be insured, and the certain-safe, who will not pay, as a genetic test does to a life-insurance pool; the tell is the seller asking for the test; what the death spends is ignorance, which no one can rebuild once the test exists, so rebirth requires a witness built not to see, as Canada's genetic non-discrimination act and the British insurers' moratorium forbid the life insurer to ask, while the American statute of that name covers health cover and leaves life cover to the test; the mirror of Farm comes back, which is death by too little known about the lot, this is death by too much.

items.item: Copy takes the crowd: a market whose lot can be copied exactly at another address dies at the old address on the day the copy holds enough of the crowd that the rest follow for the crowd's sake, as the Bund contract left London's pit for Frankfurt's screen within months once the electronic copy passed its tipping share; the tell is volume falling while open interest holds, since positions are being closed at the old address and opened at the new one; nothing is spent, the market lives at the copy, and the old venue is reborn only by becoming a copy of something else; not a market death so much as the death every other death here is measured against, since it is the one that leaves everything standing.
items.why: Tested as the left of my closest pair; separates from Slowed past the rot (see neighbor_test). Two notes for the repairer, neither a cut: 'within months' compresses a migration whose tipping and collapse ran about a year, and the item treats the market as a venue while Sunk into the bundle treats it as a lot, a looseness in the of-sentence's word 'market' that the map tolerates and should name in boundary_claim.

items.item: Slowed past the rot: a market that manufactured its thickness by fixing an hour dies when arrivals fall below what fills the hour, since each seller who leaves lowers the choice a buyer expects and the buyers leave in turn, and the market's last move is to hold the sale less often, weekly then monthly, until the interval passes the shelf life of the lot, as county livestock rings close one by one; the tell is a lengthening interval, not a falling price; reversible by anything that lengthens the shelf life or shortens the distance, as video auctions did for cattle, and the final act is usually a merger with the neighboring ring, so the thin market's death is the copy's birth seen from the losing town.
items.why: Tested as the right of my closest pair; survives because a fixed-hour market can die into bilateral contracts with no copy anywhere, and its tell (a lengthening interval) is not the copy's tell (volume falling with open interest held).

items.item: Died with the collectors: a market whose price memory lived in its buyers dies when the buyers become estates, so every holder is a seller with no memory and no buyer inherits it, as common stamps and porcelain figurines fell toward material value once the generation that knew their prices was in the ground; the tell is estate in every provenance, dealers' stock growing, and catalogues quoting prices no one pays; no rebirth of that market is possible, since memory kept in people is not resupplied, and a new generation may make a new market on the same objects with its own reason and its own prices; not Memory set to zero, where the number was rewritten, since here the number survives in old catalogues and the rememberers do not.
items.why: I was tempted to domesticate this into 'demand died with the generation' and did not. The strange claim, that a collectibles market needs rememberers rather than wanters and that a new wanter without the number starts from material value, is exactly what the item lets an operator notice, and the discriminator against Memory set to zero (number intact, rememberers gone) holds.

items.item: Wall in one head: where the wall on which offers were compared was one broker's memory, the market dies with the broker's retirement while every buyer and seller still exists, as when the only broker in used presses of one make retires and the holders go back to not knowing each other; the tell is that the market has a telephone number; nothing is spent but the comparison operation, and the market is reborn by any wall, a list, a board, a successor who inherits the notebook; not Hand on the saddle, where the missing thing is the other side, since here both sides are present and only the place they met has died.
items.why: Survives, and my boundary case (a venue's insolvency) shows it is stated more narrowly than its mechanism: the wall dies with its keeper whether by retirement or by bankruptcy, and only the resupply differs. A sharpening, not a repair; the retiring broker with the telephone number is the better teaching case.

neighbor_test.left: Copy takes the crowd: a market whose lot can be copied exactly at another address dies at the old address on the day the copy holds enough of the crowd that the rest follow for the crowd's sake, as the Bund contract left London's pit for Frankfurt's screen within months once the electronic copy passed its tipping share; the tell is volume falling while open interest holds, since positions are being closed at the old address and opened at the new one; nothing is spent, the market lives at the copy, and the old venue is reborn only by becoming a copy of something else; not a market death so much as the death every other death here is measured against, since it is the one that leaves everything standing.
neighbor_test.right: Slowed past the rot: a market that manufactured its thickness by fixing an hour dies when arrivals fall below what fills the hour, since each seller who leaves lowers the choice a buyer expects and the buyers leave in turn, and the market's last move is to hold the sale less often, weekly then monthly, until the interval passes the shelf life of the lot, as county livestock rings close one by one; the tell is a lengthening interval, not a falling price; reversible by anything that lengthens the shelf life or shortens the distance, as video auctions did for cattle, and the final act is usually a merger with the neighboring ring, so the thin market's death is the copy's birth seen from the losing town.
neighbor_test.separating_case: The author nearly concedes collapse by calling the thin ring's death 'the copy's birth seen from the losing town'. Separating case: a county livestock ring that closes because the farms around it consolidated and the remaining cattle sell by direct contract to packers, with no neighboring ring gaining a head; the market did not move, it dissolved into bilateral deals, and the tell was the sale going from weekly to monthly with no copy anywhere. Against it, the Bund left the London pit in a market with no fixed hour and no thinning of arrivals, with open interest held throughout, because a copy passed its tipping share. Copy requires a copy holding the crowd; Slowed requires a fixed hour with arrivals below its fill; either can occur without the other, so they stand. I also tried One sentence, all holders against Hand on the saddle: a pre-listing secondary market where every holder holds because the listing is coming, and where real buyers on the other side existed before the listing was pulled, is the first; an internal share market where the company was the only bidder all along is the second. They separate on whether the other side ever existed.

boundary_case: A market that stops because the lot itself ceases to exist: Kodachrome processing after the last lab closed in 2010, or any service whose sole producer quits. It satisfies the of-sentence's words, a market that was clearing trades stops being a market, and it is tempting because the map already admits deaths where the buyers die (Died with the collectors). Ruling: out, because nothing about the market died, the good did, and every admitted item has the lot's use surviving the market's death; but the of-sentence and boundary_claim do not say so, and should. A second try, a venue's insolvency such as an exchange going bankrupt: tempting because the venue is wall, witness, and clearer at once. Ruling: in, as Copy takes the crowd where a copy exists and as Wall in one head generalized where it does not, which shows Wall in one head is stated more narrowly than its mechanism.

seriation.note: Real endpoints (an address spent; ignorance spent) and the consequential adjacency One sentence, all holders → Hand on the saddle does teach: it is the crossing from what trading remakes on a new sentence to what the death refuted. Two soft spots for the repairer. Fence rots is slotted among deaths that spend an outsider-resuppliable precondition, but its own text says the death spends the will to hold the fence, which no outsider resupplies; either the text or the slot must give, and the repaired item above keeps the will clause, so the slot should move it later, after Bid that never blinks. Question nobody asks sits in the band that spends price memory, but it spends the question, not the memory; its rebirth (the machine's cost becoming a per-lot price again) is resuppliable by technology, which argues for the earlier band. Neither breaks the walk; both are bookkeeping.

edges.why: The label's antecedent (the assessor widens the basket) is real and can fail, but its consequent does not land on Farm comes back's mechanism. Widening the Brent basket produced cheapest-of-basket settlement and a wider grade that substitutes worse, which is the label's own last clause and loops back to Witness starving; nobody re-inspected each cargo to origin at a cost above the trade. The fork is real only if the label says when the widened name stops telling a buyer what arrives.
edges.repair_label: If the assessor feeds a starving print by admitting new fields to the basket, the lot becomes the cheapest of the basket and the contracts written on the old lot settle on a different good; and if the basket is widened past the point where a buyer can price the name without knowing the field, the grade's word stops saying which crude arrives and each cargo is priced back to its origin, so feeding the witness is a grade drift by another door, and the door opens on Farm comes back only when the differentials inside the basket exceed what the name is worth.

edges.why: The best conditional on the map: the copy decides whether the revoked print kills. It is the item, not the edge, that contradicts it, and the item repair above brings them into agreement.

A real conditional whose antecedent can fail (an allocation line near the old unit price does not zero the memory). form_inference calls it a passage between levels; it is a ripening along the map's own axis, from a reversible death to an irreversible one, not a crossing between levels of organization. The edge stands; the inference's name for it should be corrected.

modality_problems: Test before the pool: the American genetic non-discrimination statute is named as forbidding a life insurer to ask; it covers health insurance and employment and leaves life cover outside. Documented-history claim, wrong referent; repaired above.

Print taken back: 'took their volume elsewhere and did not come back' is asserted as history; nickel volume at the venue fell for two years and recovered strongly in 2024, and no exact copy existed to take the crowd. Repaired above.

Farm comes back: 'rebirth needs a grader with fresh credit rather than a reformed one' is speculation stated as mechanism and contradicted by the case, since the same agencies rated the revived markets under new rules. Repaired above.
Copy takes the crowd: 'within months' compresses a migration whose tipping-to-collapse ran roughly a year; harmless to the mechanism, worth softening to 'within a year'.

Decreed sacred: 'a good once declared sacred cannot be declared ordinary without the declarer looking like a seller' is an analytical claim presented as the mechanism of irreversibility; the mode statement covers it as analytical, and the seriation note honestly calls it a social rather than logical asymmetry, so it stays, but the item text should say 'nearly impossible' rests on that asymmetry rather than on history.
Sunk into the bundle: 'the ninety-nine-cent song died' is a simplification; the per-track store still sells, thinly. Covered by the general simplification limit; no repair.
duplication: none in grown.jsonl. Four items are declared reversals of the sibling fleet map market-births (Died into a queue, Farm comes back, Fence rots, Decreed sacred) and each adds a tell and a rebirth condition the birth does not carry, so they are not restatements. Warm corpse and Witness starving touch witness-architectures' subject but describe the death of a witness rather than a kind of one. Test before the pool is the exact inverse of fertile-forgettings (a gain of knowledge destroying a capacity) and could be cross-linked.
best_unresolved_seed: The edge Print taken back → Copy takes the crowd contains a second axis the map does not draw: whether a copy of the lot exists decides, for that death, whether the event kills or only deforms. The same variable runs under Wall in one head (a successor's notebook is a copy of the wall), Slowed past the rot (the neighboring ring), and Warm corpse (an underlying that still trades is a copy of the witness's subject), and it is what separates the map's deaths from the ledger's rejected deformations (prohibition, corner, crash). A map of the same eighteen deaths sorted by copy-with and copy-without would show which deaths are deaths at all only in a world with one address, and whether the four irreversible deaths at the end are irreversible because no copy of a belief or an ignorance can exist.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five items, two that failed the map's own boundary rule (a fenced right still clearing at a tenth, a starving witness whose trades continue) and three whose illustrative cases were overclaimed as history, and relabeling the fork edge from Witness starving to Farm comes back so its consequent reaches the mechanism it names; the closest pair, the boundary case, the seriation, and the band-of-ignorance inference survived.
